rules.description: tx.origin participates in a condition that can gate execution.
rules.limitations: Recognizes require/assert conditions and if conditions; does not prove the surrounding policy.
rules.remediation: Use msg.sender with an explicit role or ownership check, then add an access-control test.
rules.title: Authorization uses tx.origin

rules.description: An external interaction precedes a write to this contract's storage on a modeled execution path.
rules.limitations: Ordering indicator, not exploit proof. Source mode is local; solc mode follows bounded direct helpers, storage aliases and modifiers. Dynamic dispatch, unresolved effects and exhausted bounds are incomplete; reentrancy-lock safety is not proven.
rules.remediation: Apply checks-effects-interactions and verify a reentrancy guard with a local regression test.
rules.title: State write follows an external call

rules.description: An address call/delegatecall/staticcall result is discarded, or its captured success flag is unused.
rules.limitations: An observed use is not proof of correct failure handling; complex data-flow is not resolved.
rules.remediation: Capture and enforce the success flag, or explicitly return it to a caller that handles failure.
rules.title: Low-level call result is not checked

rules.description: The boolean from an address send operation is discarded.
rules.limitations: Requires a locally resolved address receiver; imported or aliased types may remain unknown.
rules.remediation: Handle failed delivery explicitly; prefer a pull-payment design when recipients can reject Ether.
rules.title: Ether send result is discarded

rules.description: An externally callable path delegates to a caller-derived target without a recognized preceding caller restriction.
rules.limitations: Source mode tracks local parameters and aliases. Solc mode additionally binds direct helper arguments, storage roots and imported modifiers with bounded ordered effects. No global role-integrity proof; unresolved dispatch or effect limits are incomplete.
rules.remediation: Use a trusted implementation target and enforce the intended caller/upgrade policy before delegation.
rules.title: Caller controls a delegatecall target

rules.description: An externally callable path contains selfdestruct without a recognized preceding caller restriction.
rules.limitations: Modern EVMs generally transfer the balance without deleting existing code; fork and creation-time semantics vary.
rules.remediation: Remove the operation or enforce the intended caller policy and test unauthorized calls locally.
rules.title: Selfdestruct lacks a local caller restriction

rules.description: A loop writes the whole msg.value into storage on each iteration.
rules.limitations: Tracks direct writes and unmodified local aliases; does not infer protocol accounting invariants.
rules.remediation: Compute and validate a per-item allocation before the loop, or require a single recipient per payment.
rules.title: Loop repeatedly credits the full msg.value

rules.description: A block-derived value is used in modulo arithmetic to choose an array index.
rules.limitations: Direct expressions and unmodified local aliases; no interprocedural or cryptographic proof.
rules.remediation: Use an appropriate verifiable randomness or commit/reveal design with an explicit adversary model.
rules.title: Block-derived array selection

rules.description: A hash uses packed encoding of two or more locally resolved string/bytes values, leaving input boundaries ambiguous.
rules.limitations: Currently resolves string/bytes declarations in the same source; purpose and downstream authorization are not inferred.
rules.remediation: Use abi.encode with explicit types and domain separation for the intended hash or signature protocol.
rules.title: Packed hash combines dynamic inputs

rules.description: A transfer/transferFrom/approve operation declared to return bool is used without its result.
rules.limitations: Source mode requires an unambiguous in-file interface; compiler mode uses the selected declaration across supplied files and overloads. Method names alone do not imply ERC-20 behavior.
rules.remediation: Use a compatible SafeERC20 wrapper or enforce the token's return value and test failure behavior.
rules.title: Token operation boolean is discarded

rules.description: A condition requires this contract's Ether balance to equal an exact value.
rules.limitations: Flags a fragile invariant, not a proven denial of service; intended accounting needs manual review.
rules.remediation: Track internal accounting explicitly and avoid relying on an exact external Ether balance.
rules.title: Strict equality on contract Ether balance

rules.description: A payable-address transfer in a loop lets a rejecting recipient revert the whole batch.
rules.limitations: Does not establish loop bounds, recipient trust or protocol-level impact.
rules.remediation: Use independently claimable payments or isolate recipient failures without losing accounting correctness.
rules.title: Reverting Ether transfer inside a loop
